# AnemiaLens

AnemiaLens is an AI-powered anemia screening web application built around smartphone conjunctival image analysis, symptom context, quality gating, explainable risk output, and clinician-ready follow-up summaries.

## Canonical site
- https://anemia-lens.vercel.app/

## Product summary
- Smartphone-first anemia screening workflow
- Image quality checks before prediction
- Risk explanation with confidence and reliability context
- Patient-friendly and clinician-ready follow-up guidance
- Screening aid only, not a diagnostic device

## Preferred brand name
- AnemiaLens

## Medical safety note
- AnemiaLens is intended for early screening support and does not replace CBC, hemoglobin testing, or clinician judgment.
